sections.heading: Formal purpose
sections.body:
*Para (que)* is the everyday choice. In formal speech and writing, use:

- *a fin de (que)* (in order to / so that): *Le escribo a fin de solicitar información.* *Se modificó la ley a fin de que todos tengan acceso.*
- *con el fin de (que) / con el objeto de (que) / con el propósito de (que)*: *Se creó el fondo con el objeto de apoyar a las pymes.*
- *de cara a* (with a view to / ahead of): *de cara a las elecciones*

As with *para*: same subject → infinitive; different subject → *que* + subjunctive.

sections.heading: Negative purpose: so as not to
sections.body:
- *para no* / *para que no*: *Hablé bajito para no despertarlo.*
- *no sea que / no vaya a ser que* + subjunctive (just in case / lest): *Lleva paraguas, no sea que llueva.* (Take an umbrella in case it rains.) *Anótalo, no vaya a ser que se te olvide.* (Write it down so you don't forget.) Very common in speech.
- *por si (acaso)* + indicative (in case): *Te dejo mi número por si lo necesitas.* Note: *por si* takes the **indicative** — present, or imperfect in a past context (*por si llovía*). *Por si* + imperfect subjunctive (*por si lloviera*) is also possible, for a less likely case.

sections.heading: Por vs. para for purpose and motive
sections.body: *Para* looks forward to a goal; *por* looks back to a motive: *Lo hice para ayudarte.* (my aim) vs. *Lo hice por ti / por amor.* (my motive). *Vine por verte* is also heard (motive = wanting to see you).

vocab: with a view to / ahead of
examples: Le escribo a fin de solicitar información.
I'm writing to you in order to request information.
Se modificó la ley a fin de que todos tengan acceso.
The law was modified so that everyone has access.
Se creó el fondo con el objeto de apoyar a las pymes.
The fund was created with the aim of supporting small businesses.
Lo hicieron con el propósito de reducir costos.
They did it with the purpose of reducing costs.
El partido prepara su estrategia de cara a las elecciones.
The party is preparing its strategy ahead of the elections.
Hablé bajito para no despertarlo.
I spoke quietly so as not to wake him.
Lleva paraguas, no sea que llueva.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
Anótalo, no vaya a ser que se te olvide.
Write it down so you don't forget.
Te dejo mi número por si lo necesitas.
I'll leave you my number in case you need it.
Llevé comida por si acaso.
I brought food just in case.
Lo hice para ayudarte.
I did it to help you.
Lo hice por ti.
I did it for you (for your sake).
Les explico el plan para que no haya malentendidos.
I'll explain the plan to you so that there are no misunderstandings.
Cerramos las ventanas por si llovía.
We closed the windows in case it rained.
